mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agents WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND user_id = #{userId}
SELECT * FROM agents WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM agents WHERE id = #{id}

SELECT * FROM agents a WHERE a.status = 'running' AND a.last_active_at < #{idleBefore} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM agent_messages m WHERE m.agent_id = a.id AND m.status = 'processing' ) ORDER BY a.last_active_at ASC
SELECT * FROM agents WHERE status IN ('starting', 'running') ORDER BY updated_at ASC, id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agents (id, organization_id, user_id, status, volume_name, container_name, container_id, last_error, last_active_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{organizationId}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{volumeName}, #{containerName}, #{containerId}, #{lastError}, #{lastActiveAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE agents SET status = #{status}, container_id = #{containerId}, node_id = #{nodeId}, last_error = #{lastError}, last_active_at = #{lastActiveAt}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE agents SET last_active_at = now(), updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_conversations (id, organization_id, agent_id, title, mode, model_id, archived_at, last_message_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{organizationId}, #{agentId}, #{title}, #{mode}, #{modelId}, #{archivedAt}, #{lastMessageAt})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_conversations WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_conversations SET title = #{title}, mode = #{mode}, model_id = #{modelId}, archived_at = #{archivedAt}, last_message_at = #{lastMessageAt}, updated_at = now() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_messages (id, organization_id, agent_id, conversation_id, reply_to, role, content, parts, status, error_summary, created_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{organizationId}, #{agentId}, #{conversationId}, #{replyTo}, #{role}, #{content}, #{parts, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler}, #{status}, #{errorSummary}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_messages WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND id = #{id}
SELECT * FROM agent_messages WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND reply_to = #{replyTo} AND role = 'agent' ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC LIMIT 1

WITH next_job AS ( SELECT id FROM agent_messages WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND role = 'user' AND status = 'queued' ORDER BY created_at ASC, id ASC FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT 1 ) UPDATE agent_messages m SET status = 'processing' FROM next_job WHERE m.id = next_job.id RETURNING m.*
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_tokens (token_hash, organization_id, agent_id, expires_at) VALUES (#{tokenHash}, #{organizationId}, #{agentId}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE agent_tokens SET revoked_at = now() WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND revoked_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT token_hash, organization_id, agent_id, expires_at FROM agent_tokens WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND revoked_at IS NULL AND expires_at > now()

SELECT mp.id, mp.name, mp.provider, mp.model, ch.secret_ciphertext, mp.configuration FROM model_profiles mp JOIN credential_handles ch ON ch.organization_id = mp.organization_id AND ch.id = mp.credential_handle_id WHERE mp.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND mp.status = 'active' AND ch.status = 'active' AND ch.secret_ciphertext IS NOT NULL ORDER BY mp.created_at ASC LIMIT 1

SELECT mp.id, mp.name, mp.provider, mp.model, ch.secret_ciphertext, mp.configuration FROM model_profiles mp JOIN credential_handles ch ON ch.organization_id = mp.organization_id AND ch.id = mp.credential_handle_id WHERE mp.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND mp.status = 'active' AND ch.status = 'active' AND ch.secret_ciphertext IS NOT NULL ORDER BY mp.created_at ASC, mp.id ASC

SELECT mp.id, mp.name, mp.provider, mp.model, ch.secret_ciphertext, mp.configuration FROM model_profiles mp JOIN credential_handles ch ON ch.organization_id = mp.organization_id AND ch.id = mp.credential_handle_id WHERE mp.organization_id = #{organizationId} AND mp.id = #{id} AND mp.status = 'active' AND ch.status = 'active' AND ch.secret_ciphertext IS NOT NULL
mapper.update: WITH failed_replies AS ( UPDATE agent_messages SET status = 'failed', error_summary = 'Worker interrupted' WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND role = 'agent' AND status = 'processing' RETURNING id ) UPDATE agent_messages SET status = 'queued', error_summary = NULL WHERE agent_id = #{agentId} AND role = 'user' AND status = 'processing'
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM agent_settings WHERE agent_id = #{agentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO agent_settings (agent_id, organization_id, mcp_servers, updated_at) VALUES (#{agentId}, #{organizationId}, #{mcpServers, typeHandler=com.kross.support.JsonbTypeHandler}, now()) ON CONFLICT (agent_id) DO UPDATE SET mcp_servers = EXCLUDED.mcp_servers, updated_at = now()

INSERT INTO agent_settings (agent_id, organization_id, mcp_servers, memory_extracted_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{agentId}, #{organizationId}, '{}'::jsonb, #{extractedAt}, now()) ON CONFLICT (agent_id) DO UPDATE SET memory_extracted_at = EXCLUDED.memory_extracted_at, updated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT a.id, a.user_id, u.username, u.display_name, a.status, a.node_id, a.last_error, a.last_active_at FROM agents a JOIN users u ON u.id = a.user_id WHERE a.organization_id = #{organizationId} ORDER BY a.last_active_at DESC, a.id DESC

SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '1 day')::integer AS messages1d, count(*) FILTER (WHERE created_at >= now() - interval '7 day')::integer AS messages7d FROM agent_messages WHERE organization_id = #{organizationId} AND role = 'user'
